aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.description: Your reliable partner in steel construction
aboutUs.storyHeading: The Team That Turns Steel Into Structure
aboutUs.storyBody1: Stallcons is an Ankara-based steel construction firm. From structural design and fabrication to on-site installation and technical consulting, we manage every phase under one roof. We hold engineering precision, on-time delivery, and long-term reliability as non-negotiables on every project.
aboutUs.storyBody2: We provide engineering and structural steel solutions for industrial facilities, production buildings, warehouses, logistics centers, mining facilities, and defense projects. For work in Türkiye and abroad, the scope can include drafting, consulting, delivery, and on-site erection.
aboutUs.storyImageAlt: Stallcons engineering team in the field
aboutUs.value1Desc: On every project, structural calculations and analysis precede aesthetics. A correctly engineered structure performs for decades. Appearance is built on engineering, not the other way around.
aboutUs.value2Desc: One team manages the full scope, from design to installation. No coordination gaps, no lost contacts. The same team with the same accountability at every stage of your project.
aboutUs.value3Desc: We address design, material, welding, inspection, and documentation requirements according to each contract and technical specification. Applicable standards and inspection scope are defined at the start of the project.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: A quality control approach planned around project requirements
quality.introHeading: Quality Starts at the Drawing Board, Not at Delivery
quality.introBody1: Before work begins, we review the technical specification, acceptance criteria, and required turnover documents. Measurement, testing, and verification steps from material receipt through site erection are defined in the project inspection plan.
quality.introBody2: Welding procedures, material documentation, traceability, and examination requirements are evaluated separately for each project. Independent inspection providers are coordinated when the contract calls for third-party testing or review.
quality.pillar1Desc: Design and fabrication standards, execution classes, and acceptance criteria are established from the client specification and contract documents, then incorporated into the inspection plan.
quality.pillar2Desc: Welding procedures, personnel qualifications, and inspection records are reviewed to the extent required by the project. Missing items and additional verification needs are identified before fabrication.
quality.pillar3Desc: Material documents and heat number records are checked according to the traceability level required by the project specification and linked to the applicable turnover documentation.
quality.pillar4Desc: VT, UT, MT, PT, or RT methods are planned only where required by the project specification and its acceptance criteria. Independent providers can be coordinated when third-party examination is required.

missionVision.title: Mission & Vision
missionVision.description: The values that guide us on our journey to build the future
missionVision.missionStatement: To deliver steel construction projects from design to installation, on time, without compromising engineering integrity.
missionVision.missionBody: Stallcons treats every project as a technical commitment. From project start to handover, we maintain the same standards, the same documentation discipline, and the same accountability. When the client takes over, they find a complete engineering record behind the work.
missionVision.visionStatement: To become Turkey's preferred steel construction firm for international projects.
missionVision.visionBody: We aim to convert our domestic track record into international references. Our depth in defense and aviation, combined with our industrial construction expertise, will establish Stallcons as a globally recognized name in steel construction.
missionVision.principle1Desc: Technical decisions are made independently of commercial pressure. If the calculation validates the structure, we proceed. If it does not, the design is redone. That boundary is not open to negotiation.
missionVision.principle2Desc: Projects end; relationships continue. Post-delivery technical support, maintenance guidance, and priority response for additional needs — we remain available to our clients after handover.
missionVision.principle3Desc: Every project closes with a process review. Recurring issues enter the system; missed opportunities are recorded. Tracking what we do not yet know is as much a part of our quality policy as tracking what we do.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.description: Information about the processing of your personal data

dataController.title: Data Controller
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy explains how Stallcons processes personal data in connection with its website and contact request processes.
For questions and requests regarding your personal data, you can contact Stallcons at info@stallcons.com.

personalDataProcessed.title: Personal Data Processed
paragraphs: When you submit the contact form, the following personal data may be processed:
items: First name, last name, email address, phone number, subject and message content.
IP address, user-agent information, source page and security verification information for spam, abuse and bot prevention.
Additional information that you voluntarily share depending on the content of your request.

purposes.title: Purposes of Processing
paragraphs: Your personal data is processed to respond to your contact request, make an initial assessment regarding your project, carry out quotation processes, ensure website and form security, prevent spam and bot traffic, and comply with legal obligations.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis
paragraphs: Your personal data may be processed on the basis that processing is necessary for the establishment, exercise or protection of a right; for the legitimate interests of the data controller; for compliance with legal obligations; and, where required, based on your explicit consent.

transfer.title: Transfer of Personal Data
paragraphs: Your personal data may be shared with service providers from whom we receive technical infrastructure, hosting, security, email delivery and business application services, limited to and to the extent necessary for the purposes described above.

In this context, technical service providers such as Supabase, Resend, Cloudflare and Google Workspace may have limited access to your personal data. Where required, data may also be shared with authorized public institutions and authorities.

retention.title: Retention Period
paragraphs: Your personal data is retained for the period necessary to respond to your contact request, carry out quotation and follow-up processes, resolve disputes and comply with legal obligations.
When the retention period expires or the purpose of processing no longer exists, your personal data is deleted, destroyed or anonymized.

commercialMessages.title: Commercial Electronic Messages
paragraphs: Automatic emails that may be sent to you after submitting the contact form are intended to confirm receipt of your request or inform you about the response process.
These emails are not commercial electronic messages sent for advertising, campaign or marketing purposes.

rights.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable data protection laws, you may have the following rights:
items: To learn whether your personal data is being processed.
To request information if your personal data has been processed.
To learn the purpose of processing and whether the data is used in accordance with that purpose.
To know the third parties to whom your personal data is transferred domestically or abroad.
To request correction of incomplete or inaccurate personal data.
To request deletion or destruction under the conditions set out in applicable law.
To object to a result against you arising from the analysis of processed data exclusively through automated systems.
To request compensation if you suffer damage due to unlawful processing.

updates.title: Updates
paragraphs: Stallcons may update this Privacy Policy due to changes in legislation, services or technical infrastructure.
The current version is always published on this page. For requests regarding your rights, you can contact us at info@stallcons.com.
